title: Head of Fuel Strategy
descriptionHtml:
Join Triumph!

At Triumph, our vision is a world where freight transactions are accurate and seamless on the most modern and secure freight transaction network. That’s why we’re looking for passionate, innovative, solutions-oriented people to join our team. We thrive on providing exceptional customer service and we look for team members with an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion to build successful partnerships with our clients. Because at the end of the day our goal is to help our partners businesses run better.

The Head of Fuel Strategy is responsible for defining and executing Triumph's fuel strategy across the enterprise. This executive leader will own the growth and optimization of our strategic fuel partnerships, lead the expansion of fuel offerings within the LoadPay marketplace, and drive the long-term vision for fuel-related products and services that deepen carrier engagement while creating sustainable revenue growth.
This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, product strategy, commercial execution, and innovation. This leader will be accountable for maximizing the value of existing fuel relationships, identifying and launching new fuel solutions, and positioning LoadPay as the preferred financial and fuel ecosystem for the trucking industry.

Key Responsibilities

Fuel Partnership Strategy & Management

  • Serve as the executive owner of Triumph's primary fuel program relationships and strategic partnerships.
  • Develop and execute partnership strategies that increase carrier adoption, gallons under management, revenue generation, and customer retention.
  • Lead commercial negotiations, contract renewals, pricing discussions, and partnership expansion opportunities.
  • Establish executive relationships with fuel providers, truck stop networks, card issuers, and industry partners.
  • Monitor partner performance and implement programs that improve customer outcomes and partnership economics.

LoadPay Marketplace Fuel Distribution

  • Define and execute the fuel category strategy within the LoadPay marketplace.
  • Evaluate, onboard, and manage third-party fuel solutions that enhance the carrier value proposition.
  • Develop a framework for assessing fuel providers based on customer experience, economics, technology integration, strategic alignment, and long-term viability.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Marketing, and Sales teams to drive adoption of marketplace fuel offerings.
  • Create scalable distribution strategies that position LoadPay as the preferred destination for carriers seeking fuel-related solutions.

Fuel Product Innovation & Growth

  • Develop the long-term vision for Triumph's fuel strategy.
  • Identify emerging technology, market trends, and innovation opportunities across fuel payments, fleet management, alternative fuels, loyalty programs, rewards, and carrier spend management.
  • Create and manage a roadmap for future fuel offerings that advance LoadPay's position as the financial base camp for carriers.
  • Evaluate monetization of complimentary  opportunities.

Commercial Leadership

  • Establish fuel program growth targets across adoption, gallons, revenue, customer retention, and profitability.
  • Develop go-to-market strategies in partnership with Carrier Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.
  • Build operating plans, financial forecasts, and key performance indicators.
  • Present strategic recommendations and performance updates to Executive Leadership, operating committees, and the Board.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Banking, Factoring, and Carrier business leaders.
  • Ensure fuel initiatives are integrated into broader Triumph and LoadPay strategies.
  • Build and lead a high-performing team focused on fuel strategy, partnerships, and innovation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of leadership experience within fuel programs, payments, fintech, transportation, fleet services, commercial banking, or related industries.
  • Demonstrated success managing strategic partnerships and complex commercial relationships.
  • Experience with fuel card programs, fleet payment solutions, trucking marketplaces, or transportation technology platforms.
  • Experience developing and executing product, partnership, or channel distribution strategies.
  • Proven ability to lead enterprise-wide strategic initiatives and influence executive stakeholders.
  • Experience working with both open-loop and closed-loop payment networks.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience building business cases and evaluating investment opportunities.

Preferred

  • Experience with partnership negotiations, program economics, and revenue-sharing models.
  • Strong understanding of the trucking and transportation ecosystem.
  • Background in fintech, embedded finance, payments, or transportation services.
  • MBA or advanced business degree.

Success Metrics

  • Growth in fuel program adoption and active carriers.
  • Fuel gallons under management.
  • Fuel-related revenue and profitability.
  • Expansion of marketplace fuel offerings.
  • Customer engagement and retention.
  • Strategic partnership value creation.
  • Long-term contribution of fuel solutions to LoadPay's growth strategy.

Leadership Attributes

  • Strategic visionary with strong execution capability.
  • Commercially minded and customer obsessed.
  • Data-driven decision maker.
  • Builder and innovator who thrives in ambiguous environments.
  • Collaborative leader capable of influencing across diverse business functions.
  • Passionate about helping carriers operate more profitably and efficiently.

We offer Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off, 401k and much more.

Go on.  Do it.  Apply Today!

title: VP Carrier Engagement & Adoption
descriptionHtml:
Join Triumph!

At Triumph, our vision is a world where freight transactions are accurate and seamless on the most modern and secure freight transaction network. That’s why we’re looking for passionate, innovative, solutions-oriented people to join our team. We thrive on providing exceptional customer service and we look for team members with an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion to build successful partnerships with our clients. Because at the end of the day our goal is to help our partners businesses run better.

Position Summary

The VP, Carrier Engagement & Adoption is responsible for maximizing carrier engagement, product adoption, retention, and monetization across the Triumph Carrier product portfolio. This leader will own the strategy and execution required to make existing carrier-facing digital products more frequently used, more deeply adopted, and more commercially valuable.

The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Customer Service, Data Analytics, and Sales. Success requires a deep understanding of user behavior, growth mechanics, marketplace dynamics, and product-led growth principles. This leader will be accountable for increasing carrier activation, feature utilization, engagement frequency, product stickiness, and revenue per user while creating a seamless carrier journey from onboarding through long-term advocacy.

The ideal candidate is equal parts growth strategist, product thinker, operator, and customer advocate with a proven track record of turning user engagement into measurable business results within a digital platform, marketplace, fintech, or B2B SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Funnel Performance

  • Own growth funnel performance from acquisition handoff through onboarding, activation, repeat usage, retention, referral, and expansion.
  • Define funnel stages, conversion goals, drop-off points, and improvement opportunities across the carrier journey.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Experience, and Analytics to align resources around measurable funnel outcomes.

Onboarding Conversion & Activation

  • Drive onboarding conversion and reduce time-to-value for new and existing carriers using Triumph digital products.
  • Identify friction in onboarding flows, communications, training, and product setup that prevents users from becoming active, engaged customers.
  • Build scalable activation playbooks that help carriers complete meaningful first actions and quickly understand the value of the platform.

Feature Discovery & Product Adoption

  • Improve feature discovery and adoption across LoadPay and related carrier-facing digital products.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to surface the right features at the right points in the user journey.
  • Use behavioral data, customer feedback, and usage analytics to prioritize adoption opportunities and influence product roadmap decisions.
  • Be an expert in our product and a resource to the team to best understand and ask questions about LoadPay.

Habit-Forming Product Experiences

  • Create habit-forming product experiences that increase recurring usage and strengthen product stickiness.
  • Design engagement loops that prompt carriers to return, complete high-value workflows, and expand usage over time.
  • Partner with Product to embed behavioral design principles into workflows, notifications, dashboards, insights, and marketplace interactions.

Experimentation & Optimization

  • Run experimentation programs focused on activation, engagement, retention, monetization, and referral behavior.
  • Establish A/B testing, cohort analysis, journey optimization, and rapid learning practices across the carrier lifecycle.
  • Scale what works and sunset programs or tactics that do not produce measurable engagement or revenue impact.

Communications & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Optimize communications and lifecycle marketing across onboarding, adoption, retention, reactivation, cross-sell, and referral journeys.
  • Partner with Marketing to create personalized, behavior-based campaigns that drive carriers toward high-value actions.
  • Ensure messaging is timely, relevant, operationally accurate, and tied to measurable business outcomes.

Monetization of Engagement

  • Develop and execute strategies that convert engagement into measurable revenue growth.
  • Increase revenue per active carrier through deeper product utilization, marketplace participation, expanded service adoption, and increased wallet share.
  • Identify engagement patterns that correlate with revenue growth and use those insights to design monetization programs.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, Strategy, and Finance teams to evaluate pricing, packaging, incentives, promotions, referral economics, and expansion opportunities.
  • Ensure engagement initiatives are measured not only by activity, but by contribution to revenue, product penetration, customer lifetime value, and profitability.

Voice of Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build feedback loops that capture carrier needs, product friction, and adoption barriers.
  • Serve as the executive advocate for carrier engagement and adoption across Product, Operations, Marketing, Customer Experience, Sales, and Strategy.
  • Create regular executive reporting on engagement performance, funnel health, experimentation learnings, and monetization outcomes.

Success Metrics

The VP, Carrier Engagement & Adoption will be accountable for measurable improvement across the following categories:

Engagement - DAU/MAU Ratio; session frequency; meaningful weekly actions; workflow completion rates

Activation - Activation Rate; onboarding conversion; time-to-value; completion of first high-value action

Retention - Carrier retention; churn reduction; reactivation rate; cohort retention trends

Growth & Advocacy - Referral Activity; expansion adoption; marketplace participation; cross-sell conversion

Monetization - Revenue per User; revenue per active carrier; incremental revenue from engagement programs; product penetration; wallet share; customer lifetime value

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of leadership experience in growth, product engagement, digital adoption, customer success, product-led growth, marketplace strategy, or related disciplines.
  • Proven success increasing adoption, retention, and monetization within a digital product, fintech platform, marketplace, or B2B SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to own growth funnels, improve conversion, and translate behavioral insights into product and commercial outcomes.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior leaders across Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Analytics, and Finance.
  • Strong analytical orientation with experience using cohort analysis, experimentation frameworks, user segmentation, funnel analytics, and executive-level performance reporting.

Preferred Backgrounds

- Growth Product Manager

- B2B SaaS Growth Leader

- Marketplace Growth Executive

- Head of Product-Led Growth

- VP of Customer Growth

- Digital Adoption Executive

Skills & Competencies

Growth Mindset - Identifies scalable growth opportunities through customer behavior, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making.

Product-Led Thinking - Understands engagement loops, activation mechanics, habit formation, feature adoption, and workflow design.

Revenue Orientation - Connects product usage and lifecycle engagement directly to monetization, retention, product penetration, and customer lifetime value.

Strategic Execution - Translates strategy into practical programs, coordinated execution, robust measurement, and executive accountability.

Analytical Excellence - Uses user analytics, experimentation, cohort analysis, and funnel performance to guide action and resource allocation.

Customer Obsession - Maintains a relentless focus on carrier needs, product friction, and experiences that drive both customer success and business growth.

Why This Role Exists

The future growth of Triumph's carrier ecosystem will be driven not simply by acquiring more users, but by increasing the value, engagement, and monetization of existing carrier relationships. This role exists to ensure that carriers adopt more products, engage more frequently, realize more value, and ultimately make Triumph / LoadPay the primary financial and operational platform they rely on every day.

Go on.  Do it.  Apply Today!

title: Business Development Associate - Entry Level Position
descriptionHtml:
Join Triumph!

At Triumph, our vision is a world where freight transactions are accurate and seamless on the most modern and secure freight transaction network. That’s why we’re looking for passionate, innovative, solutions-oriented people to join our team. We thrive on providing exceptional customer service and we look for team members with an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion to build successful partnerships with our clients. Because at the end of the day our goal is to help our partners businesses run better.

Role Summary:
We’re looking for a driven Business Development Associate to join Triumph’s sales team and help grow our LoadPay platform and carrier financial solutions. In this role, you’ll connect with carriers, uncover their needs, and introduce them to tools that improve cash flow, simplify payments, and strengthen their overall financial operations. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy fast-paced sales, building relationships, and turning conversations into real business impact.

This is an evergreen requisition intended to build a future talent pipeline for upcoming cohorts with anticipated start dates of November 1, 2026, January 1, 2027, and June 7, 2027.

Day in the Life:
In a typical day, you’ll be connecting with carriers through outbound calls and inbound leads, learning about their business, and identifying how LoadPay and other Triumph solutions can support them. You’ll have consultative conversations, manage a high volume of outreach, and work closely with internal teams to move opportunities forward and ensure a smooth customer experience.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Reach and exceed monthly and quarterly goals by engaging carriers through outbound calls and inbound inquiries

  • Introduce LoadPay and clearly explain its value, including faster payments and improved financial visibility

  • Have discovery conversations to understand carrier needs, challenges, and payment processes

  • Identify opportunities to introduce additional Triumph services such as factoring, fuel programs, lending, and insurance

  • Generate and qualify leads for internal sales and cross-sell teams

  • Track all activity, pipeline updates, and customer interactions in Salesforce

  • Handle questions and objections professionally while guiding prospects toward next steps

  • Share customer feedback and market insights with internal product and leadership teams

  • Partner with internal teams to support onboarding and issue resolution

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 1+ year of sales, business development, or customer-facing experience preferred

  • Comfortable working toward goals in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

  • Strong communication skills, especially over the phone

  • Ability to make high-volume outbound calls and stay organized while doing so

  • Interest in financial services, transportation, logistics, or freight is a plus

  • Ability to build rapport, earn trust, and explain solutions in a simple, clear way

  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and proactive mindset

  • Comfortable using CRM tools like Salesforce and basic Microsoft Office programs

Call to Action:
Apply now and take the next step in your career. We’re excited to meet you!

title: Client Experience Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Triumph!

At Triumph, our vision is a world where freight transactions are accurate and seamless on the most modern and secure freight transaction network. That’s why we’re looking for passionate, innovative, solutions-oriented people to join our team. We thrive on providing exceptional customer service and we look for team members with an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion to build successful partnerships with our clients. Because at the end of the day our goal is to help our partners businesses run better.

Position Summary:  The Client Experience Representative (CXR) is to deliver an excellent customer experience via phone, email and chat supporting transportation factoring & payment platform clients The ideal candidate will have experience in client service and will actively demonstrate commitment to client education, retention and teamwork. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide primary phone, email, and chat support for company inbound queues.

  • Engage in meaningful conversations with clients to ensure every interaction is fast, friendly and frictionless.

  • Ask appropriate questions and listen actively to identify areas for follow-up to better assist the client with their needs and resolve issues.

  • Provide first-contact resolution when troubleshooting inquires.

  • Holistically reviews client accounts, pending invoices and payments, A/R aging and interaction history.

  • Assists clients in resolving holds, delays, rejections and disputes as well as other related transactions or statuses such as disputes, open credits, post verifications NOA’s and LOR’s.

  • Train and support clients on how to use company web portals, processes, and other related systems according to best practices.

  • Introduce carriers to the various options for payment methods, as well as other Triumph services and offerings.

  • Assist carriers through new client onboarding process.

  • Accountable for achieving quality of service scores, schedule adherence, and call and/or ticket management.

  • Effectively communicates with team members, debtors, clients and management.

  • Maintains confidentiality of client information.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Experience & Education

The successful candidate will possess high-volume customer service skills.  Additionally, the ideal candidate should possess the following:

  • Higher education degree or equivalent customer service experience (1-2 years) in a high-volume, professional environment.

  • Knowledge of freight, transportation, and/or logistics industry is preferred.

  • Accounts payable experience a plus, but not required.

  • Bilingual (Spanish) a plus.

Skills & Abilities Required

  • Highly professional phone etiquette.

  • Demonstrates commitment to problem solving and resolution.

  • Must be able to multi-task in a high volume in an operation center.

  • Ability to perform under deadline pressure.

  • Ability to analyze issues independently.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.   

  • Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions and directions given by manager.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here maybe encountered while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phone, and printers, light traffic).

  • Ability to work in a confined area.

  • Ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time. Occasional stooping or kneeling may be necessary.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, sit, talk, hear and use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard and telephone.

  • Specific vision abilities are required by this job due to computer work.

  • Light to moderate lifting is required.

  • Regular, predictable attendance is required.

  • Add any travel or other physical requirements, as needed
